description.value: Grand Union Cafe is a family-run cafe in the historic mining town of Hedley, BC, housed in a creatively transformed old motel in the Similkameen Valley. It serves espresso drinks, rotating baked goods (including blueberry scones and coconut carrot cake), ice cream, and breakfasts, and earned a 2025 Recommended Cafe designation from Restaurant Guru. The property also encompasses nightly room rentals, art classes, and a local makers space, making it an unusually full-service stop in a small rural community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is actively open for the 2026 season at 5676 Haynes St, Hedley, BC, matching the OSM address, and the phone number 250-488-6880 matches OSM. The website describes a cafe serving espresso drinks, baked goods, ice cream, and breakfasts, with nightly room rentals and art classes also on the property. No mention of bike-specific amenities, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill was found anywhere in the website content, so those are left null.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists Sa-Su only, but the website states the 2026 season runs Thu-Mon — OSM hours appear outdated.

The Reviews subpage displays placeholder contact fields ('info@mysite.com', '123-456-7890') that appear to be unfilled Wix template elements, not real contact info; the real contact details are on the /contact page and are consistent with OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, confirmed-open cafe in Hedley, BC with an active 2026 season and strong online presence. A useful stop for touring cyclists on the Similkameen corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The property operates as a combined cafe, nightly rooms (boutique motel), art classes, and local makers space — OSM categorizes it only as a cafe, which is accurate for the primary use but understates the scope of the operation.

wow_evidence: family-run cafe ... creatively transformed old motel ... 2025 Recommended Cafe designation
